display.title: A Mitzvah as Big as Your House: Put Up a Tzedakah Pushka
display.summary_short: Mitzvos come in all sizes, from a mezuzah to a sukkah, but nailing a tzedakah pushka to the wall turns your whole house into one giant mitzvah.
display.summary_long: A short, playful mitzvah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that every mitzvah is great in Hashem's eyes, but mitzvos come in different sizes: a mezuzah, tefillin or a Shabbos candle are small; a menorah, a lulav or a Sefer Torah are bigger; and a sukkah is almost the biggest of all. Then he shares a way to do a mitzvah as big as your entire house: attach a tzedakah pushka to any wall, and the mitzvah becomes part of the house, and the house becomes part of the mitzvah. Tzedakah is a very special mitzvah that brings Moshiach sooner, and Hashem will protect the house and everyone in it.
display.lesson: Put a tzedakah pushka on your wall so your whole home becomes part of a mitzvah.
